reference_stadium: The Palace, confirmed by the owner

projected_character_shadow.source_partitions: 4 columns x 3 rows; 160 x 148 logical pixels
projected_character_shadow.destination: one 320 x 240 atlas; 80 x 74 coverage per 80 x 80 cell
projected_character_shadow.retention: only updated cells overwritten; cached cells and zero padding retained

static_goal_shadow.wrong_uniforms: shadow/pass0_colour and shadow/pass1_colour were both white RGB, so saturate(texture + 1) erased the shadow
static_goal_shadow.source_assets: The_Palace/pitch_shadow_01 and Mario_Stadium/netshadow_01/_02 are textured geometry, not shadow volumes

goal_reflection.material_0x39: clamp(light_ramp*lighting_range) * diffuse + gloss_level * gloss * specular * self_illum
goal_reflection.correction: 0x39 modulates the reflection with self_illum; it does not add self_illum to the diffuse colour

native_bounds: host-order u16 source indices; finite bounded float/S16 position arrays; no GX FIFO header offset

simulation.normal_clock: one monotonic 64-bit elapsed interval per task pass
simulation.frameskip: adaptive gameplay frame-discard scheduler removed; original asset/loading transition suppression retained
simulation.catchup: maximum 16 physics steps per render, retain debt, clamp interpolation to completed poses
simulation.deterministic_capture: explicit fixed_dt only; normal and performance validation default fixed_dt=0
